output.summary: The 98.1% figure is an artifact of the KPI definition: revisions replace the original promised date. Revisions rose fivefold only after the bonus took effect, at each center on its own start date (Pell Junction in July). Reason codes shifted to Operational-Capacity, revisions came late, and customer notification fell. The largest customer's receiving log shows 81% on time against the original date, down from 87%. Lateness complaints rose 35%, the portal does not explain this since other categories were flat, and RouteWise timing does not match. Pause the campaign, recompute against original dates, and re-base the bonus. Do not raise the bonus. Driver shortage is plausible but unproven, so the $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
